notes: Sync preservation + two-way done sync (1.11.7): (1) Smart matching in merge_calendar_events — UID link first, then exact (date+start+title), then slot match (same date, overlapping time, same subject), then title match (same date, same subject, title similarity >= 0.6 via difflib); exactly one candidate links and updates in place, zero or several means no certain match (new box, old box kept for review). A title or time change never creates a duplicate. (2) No box is ever deleted by a pull: a box whose Google event is gone is unlinked and flagged orphaned (its record stays in history / review-past); the flag clears when any feed event re-links it. Past work is never removed for its date passing. (3) Review-past view in the Analytics tab (بررسی گذشته ← کارهای انجام‌نشده) over the same data, plus per-item backlog hide flags (state.backlogHidden) — hiding from the backlog deletes only from that view and is restorable; the overdue list still shows only done past parts. (4) Two-way done-status sync via Google Calendar API extendedProperties (studyflow.done) with a done_synced loop-prevention record: dashboard ticks push to Google, Google flags pull back to the dashboard, unticks propagate both ways, conflicts resolve Google-wins, status changes never delete anything. (5) Sync is idempotent — 100 repeated syncs create no duplicates. No change to the Google-wins conflict rule, tombstones, ICS fetch, OAuth/push paths, or the programme range (2026-10-24…2026-12-18).
